video.title: AI欧腐《校霸的秘密心动/Bully's Secret Infatuation》
video.desc:
建模我喜欢 嘿嘿
Miles from Hollowbrook University disguises himself as a girl to attend Evercrest University for his sister Vivian, in exchange for tickets to see his idol Nova. As "Vivian," he clashes with campus star Damian, yet in male form Miles makes Damian fall for him at first sight. Damian mistakes Miles and his female alter ego for two people, causing many misunderstandings. Competing together in a Spartan race, they grow closer through training and rivalry. When the disguise nearly unravels, Miles learns that the anonymous musician Nova he admires is actually Damian. After facing villain Jason's schemes, Miles confesses everything, clearing all barriers as they confirm their love.
来自霍洛布鲁克大学的Miles为了拿到偶像Nova的演出门票，答应男扮女装，替姐姐Vivian去埃弗克雷斯特大学上课。以"Vivian"的身份，他和校园风云人物Damian针锋相对；可恢复男装后，Miles却让Damian一见钟情。Damian误以为Miles和他的女装身份是两个人，由此闹出一连串误会。两人搭档参加斯巴达勇士赛，在训练与较量中越走越近。就在伪装即将败露之际，Miles发现自己一直崇拜的匿名音乐人Nova竟然就是Damian。在挫败反派Jason的阴谋之后，Miles坦白了一切，两人扫清所有障碍，确认了彼此的心意。
